newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police fight Barcelona squatters.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police fight Barcelona squatters.

text.p: At least 10 people were injured and 48 arrested on Monday in clashes over the eviction of squatters from a Barcelona cinema, Spanish police said.

Local media reported police had fired tear-gas grenades and plastic bullets at squatters and protesters after storming the cinema where they had been camping for seven months. They moved into the cinema after it had fallen into disuse.
Police said in a statement their request for the squatters to leave peacefully had been greeted with a barrage of flares, rockets and other objects.
Supporters of the squatters and neighbours accused police of not giving any warning of the raid and of simply attacking the cinema's occupants with plastic bullets.

"The police carried out the operation as if they were dealing with a group of ETA (Basque separatist) rebels armed to the teeth. The operation was totally over the top," Ignaci Riera, a left-wing member of parliament, told reporters.
